name: PriceCommerce
author: cannibales1974

sections.description:
PriceCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce price management plugin designed to make updating product prices quick and efficient.

Key Features:

  • Real-time search: Find simple products instantly with a dynamic search bar.
  • Dynamic price modification: Update product prices directly in a structured and intuitive way.
  • Batch save changes: Modify multiple product prices and apply all changes with one click.
  • Clean and intuitive UI: Designed for speed, efficiency, and ease of use.

How It Works:

  1. Use the search bar to find simple WooCommerce products.
  2. Click on a product to create a dynamic price modification card.
  3. Adjust the price as needed.
  4. Click “Save Changes” to update all modified prices.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pricecommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to PriceCommerce in the WordPress admin menu to start modifying product prices.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support variable products?

No, PriceCommerce only manages simple products in WooCommerce.

Can I apply discounts or price increases in bulk?

Currently, prices must be updated individually, but you can modify multiple products before saving all changes at once.

Does this plugin modify prices directly in the database?

Yes, price changes are applied to WooCommerce product price values upon clicking “Save Changes.”
